headline: Single-Stock Leveraged Trading Volume Falls Below 1 Trillion Won for the First Time… "Interest Is Falling Rapidly"
summary: Trading volume of 16 single-stock leveraged ETFs, including 2 inverse ETFs, fell below 1 trillion won for the first time. Their share of total ETF turnover rose slightly.
why: Single-stock leveraged ETFs are high-risk products, and falling turnover in them signals changing retail risk appetite in the Korean market.
